title: Held-out examples are kept in design/held-out, and the agents' bounds are scope notes on existing values
situation: The sign-off-gates story bounds the architect's and lead's values by scope with no new cell, and has reviewers take held-out examples directly from where the architect keeps them, apart from the visible examples in design/examples.
decision: (1) Held-out examples are kept in design/held-out/, laid out as design/examples/; the reviewer's reach and review request say it takes them from there directly; the lead's and builders' text never mentions them. (2) Each bound is a note on an existing value (as principal carries 'in realization'); decision rights gain an optional sign-off slot, which only the architect and lead (and the agents built on the architect role) fill, with recommends and a note that they put handovers up for it and take it only where delegated authority grants it.
consequences: The rendered architect, lead and reviewer text states the gates; no cell's text changed and no value was added.
